browsers.name: Chrome
browsers.notes: The tab must remain visible. Battery Saver may deny or release the lock.

browsers.name: Edge
browsers.notes: The tab must remain visible. Efficiency mode may affect the lock.

browsers.name: Firefox
browsers.notes: Earlier versions use the video fallback after a user gesture.

browsers.name: Safari
browsers.notes: Low Power Mode can prevent a wake lock. The tab must remain visible.

browsers.name: Samsung Internet
browsers.notes: Power-saving settings may deny or release the lock.

browsers.name: Opera
browsers.notes: Chromium-based support; the tab must remain visible.

extension.name: AwakeTab for Chrome
extension.notes: Works while the browser is running, including hidden tabs and minimised windows. Does not prevent sleep when a laptop lid is closed. Firefox and Safari have no power API for extensions.

contexts.name: iOS Home Screen app
contexts.notes: Older versions should use AwakeTab in Safari.

contexts.name: Video fallback
contexts.notes: Requires a user gesture and uses more power than a native wake lock.
